full_page.content:
1946, September 14th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solamms Casey, O.E .. Cap.
September 14th 1945
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Mr. Joseph O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell, Chicago - O all ye works of the Lord! Bless the Lord. Sept. 14th 1946 - getting late P ...
God bless you Joseph and Winnie. Just a few words this time to catch you before going S.W. - in case you desid it necessary.
An enrolling "Emergent-lenager and Employees of O'Donell's Texas Fruit Parm." I hope things smoothe off without any serious difficulty- and that the trouble prove "just a little ripple on the surface ..... Many thanks for your kind favor of Sept. 6. I had my two Rev. Brothers Msgr Ed and Fr. M. E. Joachim last week. The latter left yesterday. Expect former back from Boston in week or so ..... Again many thanks and God love and keep you both .... Just say the Our Father sloly and devoutly for above trouble.
Fr. Solarus, O.F.M.C.
Praised be Jesus and Mary our dear Blessed Mother! Fr. Sol.
